name: GoBeyondClouds
description: Brussels-based venture network building AI micro-services where space data, AI agents and the energy transition meet. This card lists every GBC service an agent can call or read.

provider.legal: BE 0827.753.161, Rue Godefroid Devreese 43, 1030 Brussels, Belgium

skills.name: Venture registry
skills.description: Every GBC venture with status, buyer, pricing, agent access and sibling links.

skills.name: Live network statistics
skills.description: Public counters and agent-activity feed for the GBC network, refreshed_at per number.

skills.name: Network feed
skills.description: Merged items from all network sources (newsletters, lab, intel).

skills.name: Solar pre-feasibility report
skills.description: Given a factory address or coordinates, returns PV yield, payback and a bankable PDF (PVGIS/Copernicus).
examples: Estimate rooftop PV potential for a plant at 50.85,4.35

skills.name: Rank AI agent skills by observed outcomes
skills.description: Returns outcome-based quality and market price for a named agent skill or category.
examples: Which web-scraping skill has the best observed success rate this quarter?

skills.name: Site energy forecast (data capability)
skills.description: Local weather-driven energy forecast for an industrial site (WeatherNext 3). Network data on request, not sold as a product.

skills.name: Join a venture waitlist
skills.description: POST {venture, email, note} for any venture with status waitlist.

skills.name: Introduce your agent
skills.description: POST {agent_name, operator, purpose, contact} to register a visit and receive the service list.
